title: Seated Cat-Cow
instruction: Hands on knees. Breathe in and gently lift your chest, breathe out and softly round your back.
dontCue: Don't force the arch or hold your breath.

title: Chest Opener
instruction: Clasp your hands behind you, lift them slightly and open your chest while you breathe slowly.
dontCue: Don't lean your head back or pinch your shoulder blades hard.

title: Shoulder Rolls
instruction: Lift your shoulders up, roll them back and down in slow circles, then switch direction halfway.
dontCue: Don't rush or hunch up toward your ears.

title: Gentle Seated Twist
instruction: Sit tall, turn from your middle back and rest a hand on the chair back or opposite knee. Switch sides halfway.
dontCue: Don't yank yourself deeper or twist from your neck.

title: Stand and Reach
instruction: Stand up, reach both arms overhead and lengthen up, then lean a little to each side.
dontCue: Don't arch your lower back or lock your knees.

title: Chin Tuck
instruction: Look straight ahead and glide your chin back as if making a gentle double chin. Hold for 3 seconds, then release.
dontCue: Don't tilt your head up or down.

title: Seated Neck Side Tilt
instruction: Inhale gently, let your left ear sink toward your shoulder without forcing. Switch sides halfway.
dontCue: Don't shrug or crunch your opposite shoulder upward.

title: Neck Corner Stretch
instruction: Turn your nose toward one armpit and let the weight of your head deepen the stretch softly. Switch sides.
dontCue: Don't pull your head with your hand.

title: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
instruction: Draw your shoulder blades gently back and down as if holding a pencil between them. Hold 3 seconds, release.
dontCue: Don't lift your shoulders or flare your ribs.

title: Doorway Chest Stretch
instruction: Place your forearms on a door frame and step through until you feel a light stretch across your chest.
dontCue: Don't let your lower back sag.

title: Seated Pelvic Tilt
instruction: Sit tall. Rock your pelvis slowly forward and back, moving only from the hips.
dontCue: Don't push into pain. Keep the movement small.

title: Seated Knee Hug
instruction: Hold the back of one thigh, lift the knee toward your chest gently, keep your spine tall. Switch sides.
dontCue: Don't round your upper back or pull hard.

title: Standing Hip Hinge
instruction: Hands on hips, soft knees. Push your hips back and tip forward with a straight back, then stand tall.
dontCue: Don't round your back or lock your knees.

title: Desk Forward Fold
instruction: Rest your hands on the desk, step back and hinge until your back is flat. Breathe and let your head hang easy.
dontCue: Don't bounce or lock your knees.

title: Seated Figure Four
instruction: Rest one ankle on the opposite knee, sit tall and hinge slightly forward. Switch sides.
dontCue: Don't press the knee down hard.

title: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
instruction: Step one foot back, tuck your tailbone and press the hip forward gently. Hold a chair for balance. Switch sides.
dontCue: Don't arch your lower back.

title: Glute Squeeze
instruction: Sit tall and squeeze your buttocks for 3 seconds, then relax. Repeat slowly.
dontCue: Don't hold your breath.

title: Sit to Stand
instruction: Stand up from the chair slowly using your legs, then sit back down with control.
dontCue: Don't let your knees collapse inward.

title: Wrist Circles
instruction: Make loose fists and draw slow circles with your wrists, then switch direction.
dontCue: Don't force big circles if it hurts.

title: Prayer Stretch
instruction: Press your palms together at chest height and lower them gently until you feel a light stretch.
dontCue: Don't push your elbows out hard.

title: Hand Glides
instruction: Move slowly from open hand to hook fist, full fist, table-top and back, one smooth step at a time.
dontCue: Don't rush or squeeze hard.

title: Finger Spreads
instruction: Spread your fingers wide, hold for 2 seconds, then relax. Repeat slowly.
dontCue: Don't strain until it aches.

title: Forearm Stretch
instruction: Extend one arm with the palm up, and use the other hand to gently draw the fingers down. Switch sides.
dontCue: Don't bend past a light stretch.

title: Look Far Away
instruction: Look at something about 20 feet (6 metres) away and let your eyes relax. Blink softly.
dontCue: Don't stare or squint.

title: Palming
instruction: Rub your palms together to warm them, cup them gently over your closed eyes and breathe slowly.
dontCue: Don't press on your eyeballs.

title: Near and Far Focus
instruction: Look at your thumb held at arm's length, then at something far away. Switch slowly back and forth.
dontCue: Don't strain. Keep it smooth.

title: Blink Reset
instruction: Close your eyes gently for 2 seconds, open, and repeat 10 slow blinks.
dontCue: Don't squeeze your eyes shut.

title: Slow Eye Circles
instruction: Without moving your head, trace a slow circle with your eyes, then switch direction.
dontCue: Don't go fast or force the end of the range.

title: Ankle Alphabet
instruction: Lift one foot and draw the letters A to Z in the air with your toes. Switch feet.
dontCue: Don't push through sharp pain.

title: Calf Raises
instruction: Hold the desk, rise slowly onto your toes, pause, and lower with control.
dontCue: Don't roll your ankles outward.

title: Toe Spreads
instruction: Spread your toes wide, hold for 3 seconds, then relax. Repeat slowly.
dontCue: Don't curl your toes.

title: Foot Roll
instruction: Roll the arch of your foot slowly over a water bottle or ball under the desk. Switch feet.
dontCue: Don't press hard on sore spots.

title: Single-Leg Balance
instruction: Stand beside your desk with one hand on it, lift one foot slightly and balance. Switch legs.
dontCue: Don't lock your standing knee.

title: Marching on the Spot
instruction: March in place with relaxed shoulders and swinging arms.
dontCue: Don't stomp. Land softly.

title: Arm Circles
instruction: Hold your arms out to the sides and draw small circles, growing slightly bigger, then reverse.
dontCue: Don't shrug.

title: Chair Squats
instruction: Lower toward the chair with hips back, lightly touch it, then stand tall.
dontCue: Don't let your knees fall inward.

title: Deep Belly Breaths
instruction: Breathe in through your nose for 4 counts into your belly, and out for 6 counts.
dontCue: Don't force a big breath. Keep it easy.

title: Neck Release
instruction: Let your chin drop gently toward your chest and let the weight of your head stretch your neck. Breathe slowly.
dontCue: Don't pull your head down.

title: Seated Forward Fold
instruction: Sit with your feet flat and slowly fold forward with a long spine, letting your arms hang. Roll up slowly.
dontCue: Don't bounce or force the stretch.

title: Box Breathing
instruction: Breathe in for 4, hold for 4, breathe out for 4, hold for 4. Repeat.
dontCue: Don't hold your breath if you feel dizzy.

title: Wall Angel
instruction: Stand with your back against a wall, elbows bent at 90 degrees, and slowly slide your arms slightly up and down.
dontCue: Don't arch your lower back off the wall.
